translation_notes: the draft folded the three `g2.add((...))` calls per loop iteration into `g2 += g{ }`, the same mechanical-draft bias as the sibling region in this stratum (v6_7_0, and JonAnderAsua/TFG-KG-RelacionesClientelares in this batch): `g{ }` builds a disposable graph merged in after the fact, not the construction the stratum measures. Rewrote as `@graph g2` (declared once before the loop -- g2 is never reassigned, only mutated) followed by one `+{ {c} a owl:Class ; rdfs:label ... ; skos:definition ... ; dcterms:source ... }` per iteration.

kept `SEM = Namespace("http://example.org/semtech#")` and `c = SEM[cid]` as plain Python (interpolated as bare `{c}` in subject position) rather than rewriting to `sem:{cid}`: the same choice the already-final BrickSchema__Brick region in this stratum makes for an analogous `NS[var]` pattern -- keep the Python-level namespace indexing the source actually uses, translate the triple pattern around it.

prefixes actually declared: RDFS->rdfs, OWL->owl, SKOS->skos, DCTERMS->dcterms -- the four that appear as literal prefixed names in the fold (owl:Class, rdfs:label, skos:definition, dcterms:source). Following the Dewberry region's precedent in this same stratum, rdf:, xsd:, prov: and sem: were NOT declared: none appears as a literal prefixed name here (RDF.type never shows up, since it is written `a`; XSD, PROV and SEM are not referenced as prefixed names anywhere in this region), and an unused @prefix would inflate the island count without translating anything.
